## NA-AI Landing release history

Use these notes with the manifest included in your downloaded package to identify
the version you received. The [product releases hub](/product-releases) also
lists the documented versions and guides for the other PyColors products.

## v1.1.22 — Runtime maintenance

Source release notes prepared on **20 November 2026**.

This version includes the merged application runtime maintenance recorded in the
template changelog. Follow the [setup guide](/docs/templates/na-ai-landing/setup)
when installing the source in a new project.

## v1.1.21 — UI dependency update

This version updates the template dependency to `@pycolors/ui` 1.7.1.

## Updating your customized template

1. Keep a copy of the version you already use and save your customizations.
2. Use [purchase recovery](/orders/recover) if you need a fresh access link for
   your eligible purchase. The downloaded package identifies the version supplied.
3. Compare the new files with your copy and follow the
   [customization guide](/docs/templates/na-ai-landing/customization).
4. Install dependencies and check the result locally before replacing a running
   page. Apply your content, branding and integrations deliberately.

Update access follows your purchased licence. Downloading a newer package does
not update your deployed website automatically.
